types.name: Agent
comments:
/// <summary>Strong child of Ensemble and strong parent of History, Engine, Jobs and Tools.
/// Configuration lives here; each relationship is maintained at both ends.</summary>

fields.name: ingress
controlReplies
fields.comment:
// Caller-owned job controls may observe/kill independent jobs while a turn
// is busy or paused. Their replies identify those outstanding observations.

fields.name: startupReplies
fields.comment:
// Initialization has no tool identity. Track its ordinary reliable replies
// separately while joining it at the same shutdown/flush boundary.

fields.name: automaticPending
fields.comment:
// Automatic values are turn/request-local; History's ephemera slot is the
// authoritative projection once these are recorded just before a request.

fields.name: hintPending
fields.comment: // Actor writes; Job observers read this when capturing their wake pulse.

fields.name: pendingHandoff
fields.comment:
// Staged only after a successful control result is recorded. The actor
// publishes it after all companion calls have recorded terminal results.

fields.name: pendingToolClear
fields.comment:
// A host clear waits for the current batch's paired outcomes. It does not
// cancel independent Jobs, discard dialogue, or revoke skill instructions.

fields.name: nextTurnToolLimit
pendingResultStubs
fields.comment:
// Immutable proposed cuts for the batch in the just-consumed request.
// They are not History until all companion calls have recorded outcomes.

fields.name: streamProgress
fields.comment:
// Only transient delta publication advances this counter. History already
// owns durable progress. Polling status must not manufacture progress.

fields.name: agentParent
lastEmittedActivity
submissionContract
submissionReminders
fields.comment:
// Consecutive protocol corrections reset only on a durable submission.
// Failure is current-work state, not a fabricated submission or idle status.

fields.name: submissionChanged
fields.comment:
// A broadcast pulse, not a second completion record. Every observer rereads
// submittedPayload under ingress; no observer can consume another's wake.

fields.name: mainContextOccupancy
fields.comment:
// Transient main-actor measurement, never restored billing and never an
// auxiliary/direct-library send. A decimal ratio avoids integer overflow.

fields.name: memoryHandoffRequired
fields.comment:
// Ingress protects the public measurement snapshot; the actor stages the cut.
// Stage automatic maintenance; do not manufacture a model tool grant.

fields.name: memoryCapture
fields.comment:
// One actor-owned attempt. The immutable capture is not a second transcript
// store; it is the selected input whose identity must survive worker latency.

fields.name: memoryUsageImported
fields.comment:
// Process-only receipt for the retained attempt. History replay must never
// import a saved outcome into a fresh process meter.

fields.name: memorySettings
fields.comment:
// The actor applies policy; ingress protects the public immutable snapshot.
// Readiness is actor-only and never copied into the disk component.

fields.name: memoryCompressor
fields.comment:
// Fixed before the child actor starts. Its existing Agent parent owns the
// relationship and teardown; this role is not another child registry.

fields.name: selectedModel
fields.comment:
// Only Model relationship operations write this weak link under the root
// graph gate. A configured projection with no link is unavailable, not legacy.

fields.name: parent
fields.comment: // Only Ensemble's relationship methods write this back-reference.

fields.name: configuration
fields.comment: // One authoritative immutable selection, replaced only by the actor.

fields.name: engineSends
fields.comment:
// Also protects direct public Engine sends from a between-turn selection.
// The ingress lock guards this count and replacement of configuration.

fields.name: recallSettings
fields.comment:
// Like the tool-round policy, this immutable setting is ingress-protected
// and captured at turn admission. This setter does not persist settings.

fields.name: dataDirectory

types.name: WorkProductOffer
comments: // Immutable values owned by this Agent, not a second filesystem service.

types.name: AgentQuestion
AgentSettings
comments:
// Value-like disk document. This is a transfer value, not a second live policy
// owner: Agent remains authoritative for current settings.

types.name: AgentTreeNode
AuthAccount
comments:
// Value-like, deliberately redacted account status. Hosts may display this value;
// it contains no access, refresh or ID token. Email is a label, never identity.

types.name: AuthFile
comments:
// Value-like disk snapshot. It is staged inside one transaction, not retained as
// a second credential authority. Host identity survives logout and process exit.

fields.name: SelectedPlanAccount
fields.comment: // Saved launch default, not a guarantee of a currently usable credential.

types.name: AuthIdentity
comments: /// <summary>Value-like verified identity, not a session or credential owner.</summary>

types.name: AuthLogin
AuthProtocol
AuthRegistration

fields.name: Subject
fields.comment: // Null only for an issued registration awaiting its first verified login.

types.name: AutomaticTool
comments: // Value-like, short-lived selections/outcomes, not additional owners or registries.

types.name: BlobPart
comments: // A MIME type and locator, not loaded media bytes. Rendering checks model capabilities.

types.name: BlobRef
comments: /// <summary>Value-like location only. Request projection reads local paths without changing the locator.</summary>

types.name: CacheLens
comments:
/// <summary>Engine-owned, opt-in private request diagnostics. Files contain prompt
/// content and must not be published. No authorization headers are captured.</summary>

types.name: CachePrediction
ChildChange
comments:
/// <summary>Value-like observation of fixed direct-child membership. A reason
/// describes why observation returned, never permission to cancel the children.</summary>

types.name: ChildJoinUpdate
ChildOutput
ChildRestartState
comments:
// A value-like startup record in the child's own directory, not a second fleet
// registry or transcript. Current host policy and credentials are never saved here.

types.name: CodexAuthorizationException
comments:
/// <summary>Safe failure narration shared by direct callers and actor History.
/// Original file/JSON/provider exceptions are deliberately not retained.</summary>

types.name: CodexCredentials
CodexGrant
comments:
/// <summary>Value-like, exchange-local secret pair from one file read. Not a
/// record: compiler-generated formatting must not expose secret fields.</summary>

types.name: CompressionLaunch
CompressionOutcome
comments: /// <summary>Value-like bounded last outcome. It cannot revive live work.</summary>

fields.name: Usage
fields.comment:
// Documentary rows preserve actual billing identities and unknown counts.
// Loading this receipt never changes an Engine's process-local meter.

types.name: Configuration

fields.name: Features
fields.comment:
// Frozen request facts. Configured offerings supply their own capabilities;
// legacy construction resolves the catalog once, not separately per consumer.

fields.name: DeferredTools
fields.comment: // Explicit provider capability assertion; default full-declaration mode is portable.

fields.name: StubsToolResults
SafeMode
SandboxRoot
fields.comment:
// Requested launch boundary. Empty means full access. The Agent's Sandbox
// opens and retains the effective physical root; model selection preserves it.

fields.name: ProcessReadPaths
CacheBreakpoints
fields.comment:
// Explicit caller assertion of Anthropic block-cache support. Never inferred
// from a model-name prefix; ordinary/unknown configurations stay unchanged.

fields.name: PromptCacheKey
fields.comment: // Optional OpenAI routing namespace, not a cache handle or a hit guarantee.

fields.name: Account
fields.comment: // Local credential-store label, never projected or saved in History.

fields.name: Model
fields.comment: // Model is the routing name. ResolvedModel identifies opaque replay material.

fields.name: PrimaryInstructions
fields.comment: // Caller-supplied role instructions live once in immutable configuration.

fields.name: RequireToolExplanation
fields.comment: // Selected-model policy, not an inference from a provider name.

fields.name: ReasoningEffort
fields.comment:
// Validated effective request options. Empty means omit the provider field.
// These are immutable per Agent, so another Agent's selection cannot leak in.

fields.name: DisableStreaming
fields.comment: // Delivery override; canonical response content must not depend on it.

fields.name: ToolRoundLimit
fields.comment: // Zero selects 200; a positive value caps tool batches; negative is unlimited.

types.name: Context
comments:
/// <summary>Immutable replay result. History replaces this value after each event.
/// Pending ephemera is a replaceable one-request slot, never retained dialogue.</summary>

fields.name: Memories
fields.comment: // Canonical band/chronological order, independent of dialogue/event order.

fields.name: Compression
fields.comment:
// Replay receipt, not a live worker. Committed replacement and removal
// identity stay here until disk promotion/archival reaches a terminal outcome.

types.name: ConversationSelection
Credentials

fields.name: login
fields.comment: // Immutable, secret-bearing protocol state; never serialize into History.

fields.name: gate
fields.comment:
// Local lifecycle serialization plus an OS-held file-share lock for other
// cooperating processes. A leftover lock FILE is not a held lock.

fields.name: modelBindings
fields.comment: // Weak reverse relationships, protected by the owning root's model graph gate.

types.name: DiagnosticFile
DiagnosticMedia
comments:
// A pure projection of a diagnostic copy. Never used to build provider requests,
// History, blobs, persistence, or transcripts.

types.name: Engine
comments:
/// <summary>Agent-owned vendor boundary and HTTP lifetime. Render and Parse do not
/// mutate History. Only the Agent applies the immutable facts returned by transport.</summary>

fields.name: parent
fields.comment: // Only Agent's relationship methods write this back-reference.

fields.name: codexSessionID
fields.comment: // Stable affinity fallback when a frozen request has no explicit cache key.

types.name: ResponsesAssembly
comments: // Value-like Responses parse state, never shared between HTTP requests.

types.name: StreamAssembly
comments:
// Value-like, per-parse scratch state. Native blocks stay native until the
// same completed-body decoder used by plain JSON produces canonical Parts.

types.name: Ensemble
comments:
/// <summary>Application root. Strongly owns Agents and host diagnostics.
/// Supplied writers are borrowed; StartDiagnostics opens an owned host file.</summary>

fields.name: codexCredentials
modelVendors
fields.comment:
// The configured inference graph shares the root membership gate. Admission
// and root shutdown therefore cannot race to leave an unowned vendor alive.

fields.name: peerOperations
fields.comment:
// Serialize registry read/modify/replace and restoration. This is not another
// live registry: Agents() remains the sole Ensemble ownership collection.

fields.name: questionGate
dataDirectory
voiceTranscriber
fields.comment: // Protected by the existing root membership lock, also used to close admission.

types.name: Entry
comments: /// <summary>Value-like projection of one contribution, not another authoritative log.</summary>

fields.name: ToolBytes
fields.comment:
// Derived once from immutable Parts, never serialized as another authority.
// Count the actual retained wire representation, not a stub's original Bytes.

fields.name: Time
fields.comment: // Original recorded fact time; null means legacy or synthetic, never now.

types.name: Event
comments:
/// <summary>Value-like canonical fact. Payload fields are discriminated by Kind;
/// the codec and History validate them before admission. Seq is assigned by History.</summary>

fields.name: ResponseID
Memory
fields.comment: // Captured data, never re-read from disk during pure reduction.

fields.name: TaskID
fields.comment:
// Empty is an independent legacy fact. Explicit IDs never borrow another
// launch or fall back to an uncorrelated cut/population during replay.

types.name: GlobalSettings
GoalConfiguration
comments:
// Immutable configuration is the one synchronized source used by renderer and
// actor. GoalStatus is a projection; no goal text is cached or copied into History.

types.name: GoalStatus
comments:
/// <summary>Observation, not a completion verdict. DueUtc exists only while a
/// failure-backoff timer is armed. A configured file remains request instructions when off.</summary>

types.name: GoalUpdate
HandoffPart
comments:
// Value-like continuation note, explicitly marked so replacement never relies
// on matching prose. It has no permission or ownership of its own.

types.name: History
comments:
/// <summary>Agent-owned canonical log and its derived context. The optional writer
/// belongs to History; Append writes before publishing new in-memory state.</summary>

fields.name: parent
fields.comment: // Only Agent's relationship methods write this back-reference.

fields.name: gate
fields.comment:
// Snapshot readers (for example reconnecting GUI clients) never race the
// actor's append. The same gate covers events, context, and log lifetime.

fields.name: foldedSequence
fields.comment: // Sequence folded into context; retained log length is not sequence identity.

fields.name: latestHandoff
fields.comment:
// Recovery markers, not payload copies. Zero means no known boundary;
// missing legacy evidence must never authorize discarding journal records.

fields.name: saveGate
fields.comment:
// All writers share this gate. Disk work releases gate (the committed-view
// lock), so readers can still see the previous complete snapshot.

types.name: HistorySnapshot
comments: // Value-like atomic read, not another authoritative transcript.

types.name: HostScreens
comments:
// Internal backend only. Model authority and image placement checks belong at
// tool dispatch; no caller-supplied executable or output path is advertised.

types.name: ImageBudgetExceededException
comments: // A request/admission refusal, distinct from malformed media or provider failure.

types.name: IMcpTransport
Job

fields.name: observationWake
fields.comment:
// Replaceable pulse, captured once by the active serialized observer.
// Unlike output attention, a message wake is not retained for later callers.

fields.name: structuredResult
attentionEnd
fields.comment:
// End of the latest urgent progress range. The shared byte cursor consumes
// attention with its output; this is not a second question/completion store.

types.name: JobInfo
JobLimits
comments: // Value-like observation policy. Delay wakes the caller; it never stops work.

types.name: Jobs
comments:
// Jobs strongly owns every admitted Job until explicit destruction. The lock
// protects membership and pending observation settings; it is never held while work drains.

types.name: JsonCodec
comments:
/// <summary>Stateless JSON vocabulary conversion. No vendor request algorithms live here.
/// Exact JsonElement numbers avoid rounding tool arguments through floating point.</summary>

types.name: Mcp
comments:
// Agent strongly owns this manager; the manager strongly owns its clients.
// Clients never copy Agent, History, Jobs, or logging services into fields.

types.name: McpBrowser
McpClient
comments:
// One connection owns one reader and a reply table. Reverse requests execute
// outside the reader so an outbound RPC can still receive its correlated reply.

types.name: McpContent
comments:
// Protocol/content conversion is stateless. Unsupported blocks are refused as a
// whole result; no OfType/filter may silently discard an image or error payload.

types.name: McpHttpTransport
McpProcessTransport
comments:
// Owns one subprocess, its protocol streams, and its stderr drain. The stream
// transport handles framing; this boundary additionally joins process lifetime.

types.name: McpServerSpec
comments:
// Value-like launch configuration from a skill, not a live connection or grant.
// Arguments are literal argv elements; no shell performs expansion.

types.name: McpStreamTransport
comments:
// Newline-delimited UTF-8 JSON over a caller-supplied duplex boundary. The
// transport takes ownership of both streams, which may be the same instance.

types.name: McpToolDefinition
comments: // Value-like discovery data. A catalog record grants no execution permission.

types.name: McpWebSocketTransport
comments:
// Owns an already-connected WebSocket. HTTP upgrade and browser identity belong
// to the hosting application, not to JSON-RPC correlation or the core Agent.

types.name: Memory
MemoryBandSettings
MemoryCapture
MemoryCompletion
comments:
// Value-like mailbox result. Failure before constructing a child has no meter;
// an admitted child returns its final immutable measurement even on failure.

types.name: MemoryEntry
MemoryRetirement
comments:
/// <summary>Value-like explicit retirement. Empty IDs means the entire band,
/// useful for disabling a corpus without deleting its source files.</summary>

types.name: MemorySettings
MemoryStage
comments:
/// <summary>Value-like hidden candidate. It cannot become active corpus data
/// without a matching committed replay receipt.</summary>

types.name: MemoryWorkerResult
MeterSnapshot
Model

fields.name: ServingContextTokens
fields.comment:
// Configured serving capacity, not inferred from a model's advertised maximum
// and not a provider-reported next-request token count. Null means unknown.

types.name: ModelAuthentication
ModelEndpoint
ModelFeatures
ModelIdentity
comments:
/// <summary>Credential-free configuration identity. IDs are scoped through the
/// actual vendor and endpoint, rather than confused with a provider model name.</summary>

types.name: ModelRequestPolicy
comments:
/// <summary>Credential-free request options for one configured offering. This
/// value carries neither a destination nor permission to contact one.</summary>

fields.name: ReasoningSummary
fields.comment: // "off" explicitly suppresses a supported summary; empty selects the default.

types.name: ModelSelectionChoice
ModelSelectionStatus
comments:
/// <summary>A coherent display snapshot. A lost selection retains its last identity
/// so a user can explicitly choose a replacement without a routing fallback.</summary>

types.name: ModelVendor
OpaquePart
comments:
// Provider-owned replay data. Clone the JSON and preserve its origin; never
// reinterpret this as readable reasoning for another model.

types.name: Part
comments:
// Parts are immutable values, not owned runtime children. Inheritance models the
// actual alternatives of this closed union, not containment or service wiring.

types.name: PcmVoiceAudio
PeerLaunch
comments:
/// <summary>Value-like durable launch choices. These are not the running Agent's
/// mutable model selection, credentials, authority, or conversation.</summary>

types.name: PendingCompression
PersistenceOptions
PlanAuthorizationException
PlanModel
comments:
// Value-like, public provider catalog entry. Availability is not an Engine
// capability or a price; never promote a name into the local capability table.

types.name: PreparedImage
comments:
// Immutable delivery value. The image contains actual bytes, not a source path.
// Original dimensions are measured after applying the encoded orientation.

types.name: ProcessReadPath
comments: // Value-like resolved process policy. This owns no file handle or mutable tree.

types.name: Provenance
comments: /// <summary>Value-like origin, captured when content arrives. Routing aliases are not identities.</summary>

types.name: QuestionInfo
comments: /// <summary>Value-like immutable public view; it owns no Agent or pending reply.</summary>

types.name: QuestionReply
comments:
/// <summary>Value-like reply captured before the question edge is detached.
/// Sender is the actual replying Agent address, or the host's human address.</summary>

types.name: RecallAttachment
comments:
/// <summary>Recorded value, independent of disk/judge availability on replay.
/// Hashes identify full snippets actually represented, even when byte-capped.</summary>

types.name: RecallCompletion
comments:
// Value-like foreground result. Full selected source bytes allow the actor to
// recheck deduplication after hints or skill controls arrive during the judge.

types.name: RecallDocument
comments: // Derived immutable statistics, not a live filesystem or object relationship.

types.name: Recaller

fields.name: indexes
fields.comment:
// A fingerprint covers filenames and exact file bytes, not lengths or dates.
// Replace the entire set only after all sources have scanned successfully.

types.name: RecallIndex
comments:
/// <summary>Value-like index snapshot for exactly one source. Recaller replaces
/// it after a fresh corpus scan; searching never mutates its statistics.</summary>

types.name: RecallPart
RecallSettings
comments:
/// <summary>Immutable value-like policy. Zero selects the chapter default;
/// disabled bypasses recall, while disableJudge keeps mechanical retrieval.</summary>

types.name: RecallSnippet
comments:
/// <summary>Value-like attributed source bytes. File is display metadata, not
/// authority to open a path. Content includes its heading so titles are searchable.</summary>

types.name: RecallText
comments:
/// <summary>Pure retrieval operations. They neither read files nor publish
/// History, and successful judge choices never pass through mechanical quotas.</summary>

types.name: RedactedPart
comments:
// A safe replacement in derived context. Ref preserves a blob locator internally;
// text projection must not disclose that locator to the model.

types.name: Sandbox
SaveDocument
comments:
/// <summary>Value-like self-contained recovery snapshot. No event collection is
/// retained here. Legacy input is validated and folded at the decoding boundary.</summary>

types.name: ScreenRectangle
comments:
// Host coordinates are logical display units, with the primary display's upper
// left at (0,0). Backing pixels may be larger on a scaled display.

types.name: SkillActivation
comments:
// Short-lived mailbox transfer, not another owner. Clients remain attached to
// their real parents until commit succeeds or the preparing worker joins cleanup.

types.name: SkillBootstrap
comments:
// Value-like, short-lived construction snapshot. It contains immutable templates
// and explicit values, never live grants, clients, owners or service references.

types.name: SkillDefinition
comments:
// Templates grant nothing. Activation creates a separate historical snapshot;
// later variable changes cannot rewrite instructions already given to a model.

fields.name: Pending
fields.comment: // Pending is reduced conversation state, not a query over retained diagnostics.

types.name: SkillRenderer
comments: // Discovery metadata only: neither a tool grant nor permission to execute JavaScript.

types.name: Skills
comments:
// Strong child of Agent. History, not this manager, owns active instructions,
// capability grants and pending-unload markers. Definitions are only templates.

fields.name: sourceDirectory
fields.comment:
// Host-selected documentation provenance. It is not Agent file-tool authority.
// Active templates stay pinned; unrestricted discovery replaces unloaded ones.

fields.name: startupSkills
fields.comment: // Frozen host selection, not a second active-skill registry. History owns activation.

fields.name: initialVariables
fields.comment: // A server-backed startup closure freezes creation-time variables before any await.

fields.name: mcpCredentials
fields.comment: // Only referenced auth-env values; never manual variables or saved context.

fields.name: clients
fields.comment: // Connections have two strong owners: this skill manager and the MCP manager.

types.name: SkillSpec
comments: // Value-like construction inputs. Library code never reads process environment.

types.name: StoredSubmission
comments:
// Value-like historical data, not a child owner or a live completion record.
// ParentAddress is absent for v1 artifacts and unnamed transient parents.

types.name: SubmissionContract
SubmissionNumber
TextPart
comments: // Ordinary readable content, including a genuinely empty answer.

fields.name: From
fields.comment: // Optional provider material stays attached to this exact text part.

fields.name: remote
fields.comment: // A remote Tool has two strong parents: the Agent and its connection.

types.name: ToolCallPart
comments:
// A requested call, not proof of dispatch. Opaque material belongs to this call
// occurrence; Args retains exact JSON numbers rather than floating-point copies.

types.name: ToolObservation
comments: // Immutable foreground observation, not the independent Job runtime.

types.name: ToolResultPart
comments:
// A recorded result is content even when IsError is true. Infrastructure failures
// instead use ErrorOccurred. Nested parts keep the original payload structure.

fields.name: ToolReferences
fields.comment: // Discovery evidence; only the deferred adapter emits provider references.

types.name: ToolSchemaCompatibility
Usage
comments:
/// <summary>Value-like measured counts, not prices. Null is unknown, not zero.
/// Addition propagates unknown independently for each disjoint category.</summary>

types.name: UsageIdentity
VoiceTranscriber

fields.name: http
fields.comment:
// This owner owns both. HttpClient borrows its handler so failed attachment
// does not dispose a caller's test transport before ownership transfers.

fields.name: active
fields.comment:
// Retain at most the last request until replacement/destruction. A completed
// Task may be replaced; running work must always remain joinable.

types.name: VoiceTranscriptionUsage
comments:
// Provider usage is separate from the admitted audio's physical duration.
// Null usage means unreported, not free. These records contain no credentials.

types.name: WorkingContextLimit
comments:
/// <summary>Human-selected working size, distinct from provider capacity and
/// byte-based result stubbing. All quantities are whole input tokens.</summary>

types.name: WorkingContextStatus
comments:
/// <summary>Latest actor-accepted request, not a next-request prediction.
/// A completed checkpoint invalidates the old input measurement.</summary>

types.name: WorkProductInfo
comments:
// Retained description, not live authority. The opaque ID is useful only while
// the owning Agent retains the corresponding live offer. No host path is exposed.
